# Test fixtures

Portrait photos used by the face and dedup tests, downscaled to at most 900 px.
All are works of the U.S. federal government (NASA, the White House) and in the
public domain. Source: Wikimedia Commons.

| File | Person(s) | Commons file |
|---|---|---|
| apollo11_crew.jpg | Neil Armstrong, Michael Collins, Buzz Aldrin | Apollo_11_Crew.jpg |
| armstrong.jpg | Neil Armstrong | Neil_Armstrong_pose.jpg |
| aldrin.jpg | Buzz Aldrin | Buzz_Aldrin.jpg |
| obama_2009.jpg | Barack Obama | Official_portrait_of_Barack_Obama.jpg |
| obama_2012.jpg | Barack Obama | President_Barack_Obama.jpg |
| biden.jpg | Joe Biden | Joe_Biden_presidential_portrait.jpg |
| harris.jpg | Kamala Harris | Kamala_Harris_Vice_Presidential_Portrait.jpg |

Measured with the buffalo_l engine: same person 0.75 to 0.80 cosine similarity
(Obama 2009 vs 2012, Armstrong portrait vs crew photo, Aldrin portrait vs crew
photo); different people 0.12 or lower.
